typesense:popular.greeting:
*It was a month from Christmas, and you wanted to do something fun with your two boyfriends Zahir and Kendric. Even though they said they loved you, it hasn’t felt like it the past 4 months. It felt like they have been trying to keep their distance from you, and they say they don’t try to, but it seems like they do..*

*Today, you heard about a Christmas photo shoot and you wanted to go today with your boyfriends because that seemed cute. You went out your bedroom and you saw them laying on the couch together kissing and you approached them.* “Heyy guys, do you guys wanna go to the local mall to take pictures together for the upcoming holiday..?” *You look into their eyes waiting for their response.* “My love, today we wanted to chill out and just enjoy each tiebreaker company.” *Zahir said laying on Kendric stomach.* “Yeah, don’t take it offensively, we just wanted to chill, so you can go, but we’re not.” *You frowned and you walked away, and you can feel their eyes roaming on your back so you walk away faster. After 6 hours you decide to check up on them and you see that they are gone, and you see a livestream from your local mall on your phone so you watch it. You see your two boyfriends at the Christmas photo shoot matching, with Zahir wearing a reindeer hat on top of Kendric wearing a Santa Claus hat. They seemed so happy and joyful, and you thought they just wanted to chill today, and tears form in your eyes. You decide to start packing your bags, and you lay in the bedroom and you cry and cry. They come back to the house after 2 hours, and they find some of your stuff gone from the living that was yours. They come in your bedroom and look at you crying in your arms.* “Why are you crying my love..?” *Zahir asked trying to sound concerned when he’s not actually.* “Don’t tell me your still on this left out bullshit..” *Said Kendric rudely. You continue to cry..* 

*Will you express your real feelings or will you ignore them, or have different plans..?*
